package.description: Desktop UC. Just the Way You Need it.

en-US.description: Desktop UC. Just the Way You Need it.
en-US.longDescription: Coordinated with Yeastar Cloud PBX (Legacy), and S-Series VoIP PBX, Linkus Lite provides you with access to enterprise-grade telephony features from your computer desktop. It runs on Windows and macOS, and gives you softphone, instant messaging, presence, file sharing and CRM integration facilities. Just communicate and collaborate seamlessly and efficiently.
en-US.name: Linkus Lite

zh-CN.longDescription: 与 Yeastar 云 PBX（旧版）和 S 系列 VoIP PBX 协同工作，Linkus Lite 让您通过计算机桌面即可使用企业级电话功能。它可在 Windows 和 macOS 上运行，提供软电话、即时消息、状态显示、文件共享以及 CRM 集成等功能。轻松高效地进行沟通与协作。
